title: Cold Feet
caption: Cold Feet (V)
game_text: Take a ‘grabber’ into hand (or play a Defensive Shield) from under your Starting Effect. OR Cancel It Can Wait, Surprise Assault, or Yerka Mig. OR Suspend Bacta Tank (‘patient’ remains on Effect), Bo Shuda, Goo Nee Tay, or No Questions Asked for remainder of turn.
lore: Wampas pack snow around the appendages of captured prey, making use of Hoth’s cold environment to immobilize them.
